body:
OMG taylor is performing at the CMAs again!!! 🤍

the last time she played that show was 2013: an acoustic "red" with alison krauss and vince gill. thirteen years later, she's coming back.

and her toy story 5 song "i knew it, i knew you" is nominated for single of the year, so wednesday could be a very big night.

the 60th CMA Awards air live wednesday, nov 18 on ABC and disney+, with hulu the day after.

this photo is taylor on good morning america in october 2012, the week red came out. so yes, we are fully back in our red era until wednesday.

relive red on longlivets.com → https://longlivets.com/?era=red&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news

critique.rationale: Gush-first caption on confirmed news: the 2013 acoustic "Red" with Krauss and Gill, the Single of the Year nomination and the air details. The Red-launch-week GMA photo makes the throwback land.

why: Event news, intake #6840: the CMAs/ABC confirmed on 2026-11-13 that Taylor performs at the 60th CMA Awards (Nov 18), her first CMA performance since 2013. Free day, no displacement: 11-14 15:00Z (11-13 23:00Z was under 3h away). IG sibling, longer gush-first caption; same photo as the X half.
